name: browser-use
headline: AI Sessions MCP: Access AI Coding History
short_description: AI Sessions MCP server enables AI agents to search, list, and access previous coding sessions from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and opencode. It benefits developers and operations teams by centralizing AI coding history, improving collaboration, and integrating with MCP-compatible clients.
author: yoavf

sections.overview:
AI Sessions MCP Server centralizes coding session history from multiple CLI coding agents—Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and opencode—making it searchable and accessible to any MCP-compatible client. The server reads session files stored locally by these agents and exposes tools to list recent sessions, search content using BM25 ranking, and retrieve full session transcripts with pagination. Developers and operations teams use this to find past solutions, review recent work, learn from previous conversations, and resume interrupted projects. Setup involves installing the binary and configuring your MCP client (Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Claude Desktop), after which you can query sessions naturally through your AI agent.
Finding past solutions to similar coding problems across sessions
Resuming interrupted work from previous Claude Code or Codex CLI sessions
Searching session history for specific bugs or implementation patterns
Reviewing recent coding conversations and learning from previous AI interactions
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/yoavf/ai-sessions-mcp`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
